description: Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel highlighted the state's commitment to adopting artificial intelligence in key sectors while seeking concessional funding from the World Bank during his visit to Washington. He emphasized fiscal discipline and the need for global partnerships in technology and manufacturing.
body_lead: Gujarat ready to embrace AI across sectors: CM Patel at World Bank Washington, Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel said his government is ready to embrace artificial intelligence across various sectors and sought concessional funding from the World Bank, citing the fiscal discipline practised by the state. During a day-long visit here on Wednesday, Patel interacted with the Gujarati diaspora, met business leaders at the World Bank, attended a luncheon meeting hosted by India's Ambassador Vinay Mohan Kwatra and visited the Art of Living centre.
